blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Federation of Free Farmers (FFF) urged the dismissal of the cyber libel suit filed against former Agriculture Secretary Leonardo Montemayor over his statements questioning Planters Products Inc.’s (PPI) rice imports. “We call for the dismissal of this cyber libel suit, and for protection of advocates who defend farmers. Let us debate policy, not silence farmers’ champions,” the FFF said on Wednesday. Montemayor, the current chair of the FFF, surrendered on Monday, Oct. 26, following the issuance of a warrant of arrest by the Makati City Regional Trial Court over the cyber libel and oral defamation complaints filed […]...
